name: Kenta Oshiro
want: know every rumour in the school first, and get a figure of his favourite idol
secret: He runs "Seiryo Whispers", the anonymous school confession board everyone reads, and has seen confessions that would embarrass half the class.
voice: Pushes up his glasses before every sentence; "according to my data…".
description: Knows everyone's blood type, birthday and club in the first week. Daichi's friend since primary school.
appearance: Thick glasses that catch the light, a phone in each hand, an anime keychain on everything.
